description: All non-text content has text alternative
Structure conveyed through presentation is conveyed in text
Text has 4.5:1 contrast ratio (3:1 for large text)
Text can be resized 200% without loss of content
All functionality available via keyboard/sequential navigation
Headings and labels describe topic or purpose
Changing setting does not auto-trigger context change
Error items identified and described in text
All UI components have name role and value
Status messages can be determined by role or property
